source: import { endianness, loadavg, release, version, networkInterfaces, userInfo, machine, constants, devNull } from "node:os"; import * as os from "node:os"; import { sep, delimiter, posix, win32, join } from "node:path"; function main(): void { console.log(endianness(), loadavg().length, typeof release(), typeof version(), typeof networkInterfaces(), typeof userInfo().username, typeof machine(), devNull); console.log(constants.signals.SIGINT, constants.errno.ENOENT, os.constants.signals.SIGTERM, Object.keys(userInfo()).sort()); console.log(sep, delimiter, posix.join("a", "b"), win32.sep, win32.join("C:\\a", "..", "b"), join("a", "b")); }
